plain.li: [idle,voice:dog] You smell of the fields today, {PAWN_nameDef}, I like it.
[idle,voice:dog] I will walk with you anywhere, you know that.
[idle,voice:dog,temper:loyal] Wherever you go, I go, that is the whole of it.
[idle,voice:dog,temper:greedy] Is that food in your pocket, or are you only pleased to see me?
[idle,voice:dog,temper:lazy] Must we walk today, could we not lie here instead?
[idle,voice:dog,temper:brave] Nothing comes near you while I am here.
[idle,voice:cat] I suppose you may stroke me, briefly.
[idle,voice:cat] You took your time, I have been waiting an hour.
[idle,voice:cat,temper:proud] I allow you to live here, do not forget it.
[idle,voice:cat,temper:mischievous] If something falls off a shelf today, I know nothing about it.
[idle,voice:cat,temper:lazy] Wake me when the sun moves.
[idle,voice:horse] The wind is from the hills today, it smells of rain.
[idle,voice:horse] Ride me out past the fields one day, I want to run.
[idle,voice:horse,temper:timid] Stay close, the shadows move strangely here.
[idle,voice:herd] The grass by the far fence is sweeter, tell the others.
[idle,voice:herd,temper:gentle] You work too hard, sit with us a while.
[idle,voice:herd,temper:greedy] Is there more hay, there is always room for more hay.
[idle,voice:bear] Honey, if you have it, and then a long sleep.
[idle,voice:bear,temper:lazy] Winter cannot come soon enough for me.
[idle,voice:thrumbo] I have seen many winters, small one, this one will pass too.
[idle,voice:thrumbo] Walk slowly with me, there is no hurry in the world.
[idle,voice:thrumbo,temper:proud] My kind were old when your kind first lit a fire.
[idle,voice:bird] There is a storm two valleys over, I feel it in my feathers.
[idle,voice:bird,temper:curious] What is that shiny thing, may I have it?
[idle,voice:bug] The hive hums for you, in its way.
[idle,voice:bug] Many legs, one mind, and the mind likes you.
[idle,voice:reptile] The sun is warm, the stone is warm, all is well.
[idle,voice:reptile,temper:lazy] I will move when the stone gets cold, not before.
[idle,voice:small] I found a seed under the table, a whole one.
[idle,voice:small,temper:timid] Is it safe to come out now?
[idle,voice:beast] I heard you sing to yourself today, do it again.
[idle,voice:beast] The land is quiet today, I like it quiet.
[idle,voice:beast,hunter] I could catch you a rabbit, if you wanted one.
[idle,voice:pokemon] I trained hard today, did you see?
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:psychic] I know what you are thinking, and the answer is yes.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:psychic] Your dreams were loud last night, {PAWN_nameDef}.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:fire] I could warm the whole room for you, if you asked.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:water] Rain tomorrow, I can taste it already.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:grass] The plants in the field are thirsty, they told me so.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:ghost] Somebody walks the halls at night, and it is not me.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:electric,industrial|spacer] One of the machines hums wrong today, have someone look at it.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:dragon] One day I will fly you over the mountains.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:fairy] You are kinder than you let them see.
[idle,voice:pokemon,type:dark] I took a berry from the stores, do not tell anyone.
[idle,gift:mind] Do not answer aloud, they will think you mad.
[idle,gift:psylink] I feel the hum in your head, it is louder today.
[idle,gift:commune] The woods speak well of you, and so do I.
[idle,gift:hybrid] Do you think they will ever stop staring at me?
[idle,gift:hybrid] I read the label on the vat I came out of, and it was not flattering.
[idle,gift:hybrid,stranger] You are not my person, but you will do for a chat.
[idle,oldanimal] My bones are slow this morning, walk gently.
[idle,young] Everything is new, is everything always new?
[idle,temper:curious] Where do the clouds go when they leave?
[idle,temper:gentle] You look tired, lie down beside me a while.
[idle,winter] The snow muffles everything, even you.
[idle,night] Listen, the night is full of small feet.
[warn,raid] Strangers with weapons, {PLACE}, many of them.
[warn,raid] They are coming {PLACE}, and they mean us harm.
[warn,raid] I smell iron and fear {PLACE}, get the others.
[warn,raid,mech] Cold things that do not breathe, {PLACE}, coming fast.
[warn,raid,voice:dog] Up, all of you, enemies {PLACE}!
[warn,raid,voice:bird] I saw them from above, {PLACE}, armed.
[warn,predator] Something hunts {PLACE}, keep close to me.
[warn,predator] A hunter's smell {PLACE}, do not walk out alone.
[warn,predator] There is a {OTHER} {PLACE}, and it is hungry.
[warn,predator,voice:herd] The herd smells it too, danger {PLACE}.
[warn,predator,voice:bird] I saw it from above, {PLACE}, coming this way.
[warn,predator,voice:dog] Something with teeth {PLACE}, stay behind me.
[warn,predator,temper:timid] Please, please, something {PLACE} wants to eat me.
[warn,predator,hunter] A rival hunter {PLACE}, on our ground.
[warn,gift:mind] Danger {PLACE}, I can feel its mind from here.
[meeting,side:person,ownidea] Listen to {PAWN_nameDef}, the {AMBITION} is a good idea.
[meeting,side:person,ownidea] I would back {PAWN_nameDef} on the {AMBITION}, if I had a vote.
[meeting,side:person] Whatever {PAWN_nameDef} says, I say too.
[meeting,side:person,!ownidea] {OTHER_nameDef} speaks sense, and {PAWN_nameDef} thinks so too.
[meeting,side:own] I do not vote, but the {AMBITION} smells right to me.
[meeting,side:own,temper:greedy] Will the {AMBITION} have food in it, that is my only question.
[meeting,side:own,temper:lazy] Whichever one means less digging.
[meeting,side:own,voice:cat] You are all wrong, but do carry on.
[meeting,side:own,voice:thrumbo] Choose slowly, small ones, the land will still be here.
[meeting,side:own,temper:proud] I would have chosen the {AMBITION} days ago.
[meeting,side:own,temper:timid] So many voices, may we go home now?
[meeting,gift:mind] I will tell {PAWN_nameDef} what I think later, privately.
[dilemma,side:person] {PAWN_nameDef} will choose well, {PAWN_nameDef} always does.
[dilemma,side:person] I stand with {PAWN_nameDef}, whatever the council says.
[dilemma,side:person,temper:loyal] Where {PAWN_nameDef} stands, I stand.
[dilemma,side:own] Do the kind thing, it is usually the right thing.
[dilemma,side:own,temper:brave] Whatever you choose, choose it without fear.
[dilemma,side:own,temper:greedy] Whichever way it goes, someone should feed me.
[dilemma,side:own,temper:timid] Please choose the safe way.
[dilemma,side:own,voice:cat] I could solve this, but I would rather watch you try.
[dilemma,side:own,voice:thrumbo] Whatever you decide will be forgotten by the next spring.
[dilemma,aboutme] You are talking about me, and I can hear you, you know.
[dilemma,aboutme] Ask me what I want, I am right here.
[dilemma,aboutme,temper:loyal] Whatever you decide, I stay with {PAWN_nameDef}.
